summary: One dialogue/message window instance: owns a message record, walks its pages, draws text/glyph pages, spawns the speaker portrait/voice, sets message arguments and drives the 2D/3D presentation state machine.
evidence: Ui_Message_Reset/Update 0x004EC41C/0x004E95E0 drive a state id at +0x1380, a page index at +0x1264 and a message record at +0x12D8; SetName* fill message arguments from +0x208..+0x21C. Many listed offsets are vtable-slot numbers scraped from `(**(code **)(*param_1 + N))` calls; those are marked confidence 0.0. The six weak fields at 0x92F4.. belong to the caller's actor object (Ui_Message_ResolveSpeakerName is called from Actor_LinkSubObjectNodes / Field_SceneSpawnBlock_NpcColorBalloon), not to this 0x13F0-byte class.

fields.evidence: Class has vtable 0x0077B8F0; every polymorphic method dispatches through word 0.

fields.name: actorRefKind
fields.evidence: Actor_ResolveReferenceObject (0x00668CCC) switches on this byte: kind 0/1 pick entries out of the two roster tables, kind 2 reads a u16 id at +0xe, kinds 3/4 return the default objects. SetArgsFromRecordB (0x00632EA0) passes &self->f_c as that reference descriptor and only fills message args 2/3/5 w

fields.name: actorRosterIndex
fields.evidence: Actor_ResolveReferenceObject (0x00668CCC) case 0 reads the u32 at ref+4 (this field, index 0 of the inline list bounded at ref+0x24) as a party-roster index, then adds it to the spirit roster; SetArgsFromRecordB (0x00632EA0) resolves index 0 of &self->f_c through it for message arg 2.

fields.name: portraitActor
fields.evidence: PlayAttractAnim/PlayIdleAnim hand this pointer to Actor_SelectAttractAnimation (0x002340B0) as the actor and then read vtable slot +0x84 / field +0x160 on it, so it is the actor model whose idle/attract animation the window drives.

summary: A skill-panel message panel: keeps a 0x1C-stride skill row table, the owning character id, per-row panel types, the selected row id and the cost-label list, resolves the target row and drives a small screen-shake/smooth-position animation.
evidence: maybe_Ui_PanelMessage_ResolveTargetPos (0x001DDF9C) walks rows at +0x74 with count +0x78, reads row+8 as a skill id, calls SkillPanel_CanUnlockSkill(characterId, skillId, panelType) with +0x199/+0x1DC[]; UpdatePrices (0x001E2758) updates ten cost labels through +0x194 with a 1/10/100 multiplier at +0x228. CanAdvance (0x00643A2C) gates on +0x1C4/+0x1C8. The generated 'PanelMessage' name is kept.

summary: Small recipe message widget: a 0x10-byte command/list header plus an embedded Ui_Object constructed at +0xA0 that is registered as an update node and filled with Ui_Recipe_BuildGetMessage(recipeId, mode).
